name: Griffith Observatory
desc: Free telescopes, free skyline, free existential moment over the whole glittering basin. Go at dusk.

name: Venice Beach Boardwalk
desc: Muscle beach, street performers, ocean haze. The weirdest free show in America, daily.

name: Santa Monica Pier
desc: Where Route 66 runs out of road. The ferris wheel lights hit different when you're broke and dreaming.

name: Hollywood Sign Hike
desc: Sweat your way up to nine white letters and a view that explains why everyone keeps moving here.

name: The Getty Center
desc: A billion-dollar hilltop art palace with free admission. The tram ride up feels like winning something.

name: Grand Central Market
desc: A century of downtown eating under one neon roof. Walk every stall twice before committing your $8.

name: The Broad
desc: Free contemporary art in a honeycomb spaceship. Book ahead and act like you always do this.

name: Runyon Canyon
desc: LA's unofficial dog park slash outdoor gym. Come for the trail, stay for the golden-hour city views.

name: Hollywood Walk of Fame
desc: Stars underfoot for miles, zero dollars. Find your favorite name and take the picture. It's the law.

name: LACMA
desc: The glowing lamppost forest outside is free forever. The art inside is your treat-yourself day.
